policies.title: Expense record retention
policies.text: Approved expense reports, receipts, and reimbursement records must be retained for seven years after the end of the fiscal year. Finance owns the retention schedule.

policies.title: Non-recurring spend approval
policies.text: Non-recurring vendor spend above 5,000 dollars requires budget-owner approval before a purchase order is issued. Spend above 25,000 dollars also requires Finance approval.

policies.title: Privileged access review
policies.text: Privileged access is granted for a documented business purpose, reviewed every 90 days, and removed within one business day when the purpose ends or employment changes.

policies.title: Security incident reporting
policies.text: Suspected security incidents must be reported immediately through the incident channel. Do not include credentials, regulated personal data, or customer secrets in the report.

policies.title: Flexible work eligibility
policies.text: Flexible work arrangements are agreed by the employee and manager and reviewed quarterly. The arrangement must preserve team coverage, data-security requirements, and core meeting obligations.
